row.evidence: G-P's integrations page says customers can "Automate your user lifecycle by integrating G-P with Okta or Auth0 for instant provisioning or de-provisioning", but no SCIM endpoint, setup guide or plan gate is published.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Sold as G-P; pricing is per hired worker, not per admin seat (EOR from USD 599 per employee/month, Contractor from USD 39 per contractor/month, Gia from USD 500 per seat/month), so per-user fields stay null. Marketing pages claim SSO (Google Workspace, Entra ID) and Okta/Auth0 provisioning, but no help-centre or developer documentation describes the mechanism, protocol or plan, and Okta's OIN has no G-P app, so status stays unknown rather than gated. The public G-P API (OAuth client credentials) covers EOR/contractor HR records, not platform users; as an HR/EOR system its data could be a source for an IdP, which is not scored.

scim.notes: G-P's integrations page says Okta/Auth0 can provision and de-provision G-P users, but no SCIM endpoint, setup guide or plan is published; the developer portal (EOR, Contractor and Authentication APIs) has no SCIM or user-account resource, and Okta's OIN search finds no G-P app.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant returning a JWT bearer token (https://api.g-p.com/api/oauth/token).

endpoints.purpose: List EOR employees (HR records, not platform users)

user_api.notes: The G-P API exposes EOR employee and contractor HR records (employees, employments, contracts, payroll, invoices, change requests), not G-P platform login accounts or roles, so it is not counted as a user-management API.

okta.notes: No OIN app found; G-P's marketing page claims Okta/Auth0 provisioning without documentation.

entra.notes: Marketing page lists Entra ID; no gallery app or tutorial found (tutorial URLs 404).

google.notes: Google Workspace sign-in listed on the integrations page.

fallbacks.other_sync: HCM/payroll integrations (Workday, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, TriNet) exchange worker data
fallbacks.notes: No public help centre for SSO or provisioning setup was found.
